description: The two SCRAPED weapon enchants, kept when the Classic and Season of Discovery item files were deleted. They are not items and were never stand-ins: Crusader and Weapon Spell Power have a real Wowhead spell id, an icon and a tooltip, and every preset still names one. The other 28 enchants are the ruleset owner's own table and live in game/items/foreverEnchants.ts, declared rather than scraped.
source: https://nether.wowhead.com/classic/tooltip/spell/<id> -- carried over from classic-warrior.json, which held them alongside its items
